card.name: Diarrhea in CDAD warning; overdose care wording
card.fires_on: Mostly the word diarrhea in the stock warning that C. difficile disease must be considered in patients who present with diarrhea after antibacterial use. It also fires on a few words in overdose management sentences.

modes.label: Diarrhea in CDAD warning
modes.description: The word diarrhea right after 'patients who present with' in the C. difficile-associated diarrhea warning.
modes.example: CDAD must be considered in all patients who present with<< diarrhea>> following antibiotic use.

modes.label: Overdose care wording
modes.description: A linking word in overdose management text about monitoring, lavage and charcoal.
modes.example: Careful observation and cardiac and vital sign monitoring are recommended,<< along>> with general symptomatic and supportive care.

card.plain: It marks the word diarrhea in the standard C. difficile warning, and a few spots in overdose-care advice.
